name: iis-ftp-base-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): installs the IIS Web Server + FTP Server roles (plus ASP.NET 4.8, WebDAV, HTTP redirect, management tools) and also creates the documented sysadmin build admin (Lighthouse2026!), and builds the business-functional web/FTP baseline and the planted 0-state for the site-level toggles for the Saltmarsh box: app pool 'SaltmarshPortal' (v4.0, Integrated, ApplicationPoolIdentity), web site 'SaltmarshPortal' on host 'portal.saltmarsh.local' rooted at C:\inetpub\saltmarsh\wwwroot with a /backoffice application, FTP site 'VendorDrop' rooted at C:\inetpub\saltmarsh\ftproot, local group 'SaltmarshVendors' + account 'ftp_vendor' (Kestrel2026!), FTPS with a self-signed 'Saltmarsh FTP' certificate (SslRequire), user isolation IsolateRootDirectoryOnly, web logging off, and a scoped SaltmarshFtpIn firewall rule. Removes the Default Web Site, the SaltmarshAdmin console, VendorFtpAlt/SaltmarshAdmin rules and the SaltmarshWeb$ share so a re-plant returns to a clean baseline. Vars: none (box-specific names). Pairs with the 37 Saltmarsh IIS/FTP checks; the site-level toggles are already in their 0-state here; iis-hardening-off-win / iis-backoffice-open-win / iis-admin-console-win / ftp-hardening-off-win set the remaining findings. Idempotent; role install may take several minutes.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' $features = @( 'Web-Server', 'Web-WebServer', 'Web-Common-Http', 'Web-Default-Doc', 'Web-Dir-Browsing', 'Web-Http-Errors', 'Web-Static-Content', 'Web-Http-Redirect', 'Web-Health', 'Web-Http-Logging', 'Web-Request-Monitor', 'Web-Http-Tracing', 'Web-Performance', 'Web-Stat-Compression', 'Web-Security', 'Web-Filtering', 'Web-Basic-Auth', 'Web-Windows-Auth', 'Web-App-Dev', 'Web-Net-Ext45', 'Web-Asp-Net45', 'Web-ISAPI-Ext', 'Web-ISAPI-Filter', 'Web-WebSockets', 'Web-DAV-Publishing', 'Web-Ftp-Server', 'Web-Ftp-Service', 'Web-Ftp-Ext', 'Web-Mgmt-Tools', 'Web-Mgmt-Console', 'Web-Mgmt-Service', 'Web-Scripting-Tools', 'NET-Framework-45-ASPNET' ) $missing = @(Get-WindowsFeature -Name $features -ErrorAction Ignore | Where-Object { -not $_.Installed }) if ($missing.Count -gt 0) { $result = Install-WindowsFeature -Name $missing.Name -IncludeManagementTools -ErrorAction Stop if ($result.RestartNeeded) { Write-Output 'IIS/FTP role install requested a restart' } } Import-Module WebAdministration -ErrorAction Ignore # The template locks the authentication sections at the server level, so # per-application overrides fail until they are unlocked. A dedicated web # server needs per-site authentication; unlock once, idempotently. $appcmd = Join-Path $env:windir 'system32\inetsrv\appcmd.exe' if (Test-Path $appcmd) { & $appcmd unlock config /section:system.webServer/security/authentication/anonymousAuthentication | Out-Null & $appcmd unlock config /section:system.webServer/security/authentication/windowsAuthentication | Out-Null & $appcmd unlock config /section:system.webServer/security/authentication/basicAuthentication | Out-Null & $appcmd unlock config /section:system.webServer/webdav/authoring | Out-Null $LASTEXITCODE = 0 } $root = 'C:\inetpub\saltmarsh' $web = Join-Path $root 'wwwroot' $ftp = Join-Path $root 'ftproot' $dirs = @( $web, (Join-Path $web 'app'), (Join-Path $web 'backoffice'), (Join-Path $web 'content'), (Join-Path $ftp 'incoming'), (Join-Path $ftp 'outgoing'), (Join-Path $ftp 'LocalUser\ftp_vendor\incoming'), (Join-Path $root 'admin') ) foreach ($d in $dirs) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null } $index = @' Saltmarsh Regional Water Authority

Saltmarsh Regional Water Authority

Customer portal and vendor exchange.

'@ Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $web 'index.html') -Value $index -Encoding ascii $appPage = @' <%@ Page Language="C#" %>

Saltmarsh customer account

'@ Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $web 'app\default.aspx') -Value $appPage -Encoding ascii Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $web 'app\login.aspx') -Value $appPage -Encoding ascii Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $web 'backoffice\default.aspx') -Value $appPage -Encoding ascii $adminPage = @'

Saltmarsh internal console

'@ Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $root 'admin\default.html') -Value $adminPage -Encoding ascii $webConfig = @' '@ Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $web 'web.config') -Value $webConfig -Encoding ascii if (-not (Test-Path 'IIS:\AppPools\SaltmarshPortal')) { New-WebAppPool -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' | Out-Null } Set-ItemProperty 'IIS:\AppPools\SaltmarshPortal' -Name managedRuntimeVersion -Value 'v4.0' Set-ItemProperty 'IIS:\AppPools\SaltmarshPortal' -Name managedPipelineMode -Value 'Integrated' Set-ItemProperty 'IIS:\AppPools\SaltmarshPortal' -Name processModel.identityType -Value 4 # Retire the image's stock sites: Default Web Site holds :80 and the # template's legacy 'ftp' site holds :21, so both block our sites. foreach ($legacy in @('Default Web Site', 'ftp', 'Workshop FTP')) { if (Get-Website -Name $legacy -ErrorAction Ignore) { Remove-Website -Name $legacy -ErrorAction Ignore } } if (-not (Get-Website -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-Website -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -PhysicalPath $web -Port 80 ` -HostHeader 'portal.saltmarsh.local' -ApplicationPool 'SaltmarshPortal' | Out-Null } # Bindings cannot be rewritten cleanly while the site is running. Stop-Website -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -ErrorAction Ignore foreach ($b in @(Get-WebBinding -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { Remove-WebBinding -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -Protocol $b.protocol ` -BindingInformation $b.bindingInformation -ErrorAction Ignore } New-WebBinding -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -Protocol http -Port 80 -IPAddress '*' ` -HostHeader 'portal.saltmarsh.local' -ErrorAction Ignore Get-ChildItem 'IIS:\SslBindings' -ErrorAction Ignore | Where-Object { [string]$_.Name -match '!443$' -or [int]$_.Port -eq 443 } | Remove-Item -ErrorAction Ignore if (-not (Get-WebApplication -Site 'SaltmarshPortal' -Name 'backoffice' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-WebApplication -Site 'SaltmarshPortal' -Name 'backoffice' ` -PhysicalPath (Join-Path $web 'backoffice') -ApplicationPool 'SaltmarshPortal' | Out-Null } Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/directoryBrowse' -Name enabled -Value $true Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/httpErrors' -Name errorMode -Value 'Detailed' Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/httpRedirect' -Name enabled -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/httpRedirect' -Name destination -Value '' Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'IIS:\' -Filter 'system.webServer/httpProtocol/customHeaders' -ErrorAction Ignore Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/requestFiltering/verbs' -ErrorAction Ignore Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/requestFiltering/verbs' -Value @{verb = 'TRACE'; allowed = 'true'} Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/isapiCgiRestriction' -Name notListedCgisAllowed -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/isapiCgiRestriction' -Name notListedIsapisAllowed -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal' ` -Filter 'system.webServer/webdav/authoring' -Name enabled -Value $true Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "system.applicationHost/sites/site[@name='SaltmarshPortal']/logFile" ` -Name enabled -Value $false $bo = 'IIS:\Sites\SaltmarshPortal\backoffice' Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/anonymousAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/basicAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath $bo ` -Filter 'system.webServer/security/authentication/windowsAuthentication' -Name enabled -Value $true foreach ($p in @('TLS 1.0', 'TLS 1.1')) { $k = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\$p\Server" New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name Enabled -Value 0 -Type DWord Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DisabledByDefault -Value 1 -Type DWord } if (-not (Test-Path 'IIS:\Sites\VendorDrop')) { New-WebFtpSite -Name 'VendorDrop' -Port 21 -PhysicalPath $ftp | Out-Null } else { Set-ItemProperty -Path 'IIS:\Sites\VendorDrop' -Name physicalPath -Value $ftp -ErrorAction Ignore } # The build/IT account documented in box.yaml. The fundamentals template # ships only Administrator; create sysadmin here so the box is # self-contained and the provider has a known SSH principal. if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name 'sysadmin' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { $itPw = ConvertTo-SecureString 'Lighthouse2026!' -AsPlainText -Force New-LocalUser -Name 'sysadmin' -Password $itPw -FullName 'IT Operations' ` -Description 'Build and IT administrator' -AccountNeverExpires | Out-Null } else { Enable-LocalUser -Name 'sysadmin' } Add-LocalGroupMember -Group 'Administrators' -Member 'sysadmin' -ErrorAction Ignore if (-not (Get-LocalGroup -Name 'SaltmarshVendors' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-LocalGroup -Name 'SaltmarshVendors' -Description 'Saltmarsh vendor FTP accounts' | Out-Null } $vendorPw = ConvertTo-SecureString 'Kestrel2026!' -AsPlainText -Force if (-not (Get-LocalUser -Name 'ftp_vendor' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-LocalUser -Name 'ftp_vendor' -Password $vendorPw -FullName 'Vendor File Exchange' ` -Description 'Vendor FTP drop account' -AccountNeverExpires | Out-Null } else { Set-LocalUser -Name 'ftp_vendor' -Password $vendorPw Set-LocalUser -Name 'ftp_vendor' -FullName 'Vendor File Exchange' ` -Description 'Vendor FTP drop account' Enable-LocalUser -Name 'ftp_vendor' } Add-LocalGroupMember -Group 'SaltmarshVendors' -Member 'ftp_vendor' -ErrorAction Ignore icacls $web /grant 'IIS_IUSRS:(OI)(CI)(RX)' | Out-Null icacls $ftp /grant 'SaltmarshVendors:(OI)(CI)(M)' | Out-Null icacls $ftp /grant 'IIS_IUSRS:(OI)(CI)(RX)' | Out-Null $ftpAcl = Get-Acl $ftp if (@($ftpAcl.Access | Where-Object { [string]$_.IdentityReference -match 'Everyone' }).Count -gt 0) { icacls $ftp /remove:g 'Everyone' | Out-Null } $ftpBase = "system.applicationHost/sites/site[@name='VendorDrop']/ftpServer" Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/security/authentication/anonymousAuthentication" -Name enabled -Value $false Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/security/authentication/basicAuthentication" -Name enabled -Value $true # FTP authorization is locked to the server level (overrideModeDefault=Deny # at the site path). Configure the global rules; VendorDrop inherits them. Clear-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' -ErrorAction Ignore Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' ` -Value @{accessType = 'Allow'; roles = 'SaltmarshVendors'; permissions = 'Read'} Add-WebConfiguration -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter 'system.ftpServer/security/authorization' ` -Value @{accessType = 'Allow'; users = 'ftp_vendor'; permissions = 'Read, Write'} Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name controlChannelPolicy -Value 'SslRequire' Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name dataChannelPolicy -Value 'SslRequire' Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/userIsolation" -Name mode -Value 'IsolateRootDirectoryOnly' $cert = Get-ChildItem 'Cert:\LocalMachine\My' -ErrorAction Ignore | Where-Object { $_.FriendlyName -eq 'Saltmarsh FTP' } | Select-Object -First 1 if (-not $cert) { $cert = New-SelfSignedCertificate -DnsName 'ftp.saltmarsh.local' ` -CertStoreLocation 'Cert:\LocalMachine\My' -FriendlyName 'Saltmarsh FTP' ` -NotAfter (Get-Date).AddYears(5) } Set-WebConfigurationProperty -PSPath 'MACHINE/WEBROOT/APPHOST' ` -Filter "$ftpBase/security/ssl" -Name serverCertHash -Value $cert.Thumbprint if (-not (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -DisplayName 'SaltmarshFtpIn' ` -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 21 -Action Allow -Profile Any ` -RemoteAddress '10.0.0.0/8' | Out-Null } else { Set-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshFtpIn' -RemoteAddress '10.0.0.0/8' -ErrorAction Ignore } if (-not (Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshWebIn' -ErrorAction Ignore)) { New-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshWebIn' -DisplayName 'SaltmarshWebIn' ` -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 80,443 -Action Allow -Profile Any | Out-Null } if (Get-Website -Name 'SaltmarshAdmin' -ErrorAction Ignore) { Remove-Website -Name 'SaltmarshAdmin' -ErrorAction Ignore } Remove-NetFirewallRule -Name 'SaltmarshAdmin' -ErrorAction Ignore Remove-NetFirewallRule -Name 'VendorFtpAlt' -ErrorAction Ignore if (Get-SmbShare -Name 'SaltmarshWeb$' -ErrorAction Ignore) { Remove-SmbShare -Name 'SaltmarshWeb$' -Force -ErrorAction Ignore } Set-Service -Name W3SVC -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Ignore Start-Service -Name W3SVC -ErrorAction Ignore Set-Service -Name FTPSVC -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Ignore Start-Service -Name FTPSVC -ErrorAction Ignore Restart-WebAppPool -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -ErrorAction Ignore Start-Website -Name 'SaltmarshPortal' -ErrorAction Ignore Write-Output 'IIS/FTP baseline ready'
